text:
Avery King: customer asked for a cost preview in Console for embeddings. they do large mixed-dim batches and are surprised by bills. idea: add a lightweight "units preview" before submit
Lina Morales: +1. lightweight client hint header so Console can show instant numbers. propose header `X-Embed-Units-Hint` format: `units=42;ver=1;active=120;sparse=0.15`
Tom Baker: for compute: use active_dims * w_dim + ceil(bytes/2048) * w_kb + sparsity_factor * w_sparse. keep weights per-model but expose a model-agnostic fallback so SDKs can estimate without a profile
Sahil Mehta: important: header is advisory. runtime may split or prefetch and change units. server should respond with `X-Embed-Units-Calc: units=45;split=2;profile=embed-v3` when final differs
Avery King: Console UX idea: show two modes "fast preview" (client hint) and "server preview" (after response). allow users to toggle conservative/aggressive estimator that biases toward server-splitting behavior
Lina Morales: implementation detail: add optional hint headers `X-Embed-Active-Dim` and `X-Embed-Sparse-Ratio` for clients that want more accurate quick previews without sending vectors. these are tiny ints/decimals so safe to send
Tom Baker: unit tests: SDK estimator vs server estimator parity on typical corpuses, plus fuzz tests for extreme sparsity and giant byte payloads. add integration test where Console updates overlay when `X-Embed-Units-Calc` returned
Sahil Mehta: telemetry: record client_hint_units, server_units, split_count, sdk_version, route, model. store median delta by model and by sdk. create alert when median delta > 25% for 30m
opsbot: suggestion: show inline badge in Console: green if delta <10%, yellow 10-30%, red >30% with link to "why this differs". if server returns split plan, show "Preview split" quickview
Avery King: failure modes: if server returns 413 and suggests async-split, response includes `X-Embed-Async-Plan-URL` we can surface as a one-click convert-to-async action in Console
Lina Morales: rollout: opt-in header for SDKs and Console previews behind ff:embed_units_preview 0.01 -> 0.1 -> 0.5 -> GA. collect telemetry for 2 weeks at each stage
Tom Baker: security note: never log raw vectors. telemetry must only contain counts, hashes, or booleans. make sure headers are rate-limited and low-cardinality
Sahil Mehta: I'll draft the server header spec + unit parity tests. Lina can own SDK helpers and Console wiring. Avery will coordinate rollout docs and support playbook
Avery King: thanks all. I'll open the PR with spec + Console mockups and tag reviewers :rocket:
